detailed_findings.finding: The argument that A_r meets S because A_r is infinite while the gap set is finite is valid and gives existence of w_r.
The characterization of gaps in residue class r as exactly {r,r+m,...,r+(k_r-1)m} is complete and uses only closure under addition and minimality of w_r.
The final counting step correctly partitions N0 \ S by residue class modulo m, with class 0 containing no gaps because all multiples of m lie in S.

reason: The proof correctly establishes existence of the Apéry representatives w_r using cofiniteness of a numerical semigroup, shows that each residue class r=1,...,m-1 has exactly k_r gaps, and sums these counts over residue classes, with residue class 0 contributing none. This matches the stated lemma and aligns with the intended Kunz/genus interpretation used downstream.
